representations.name: Factor-labelled low-moment incidence tensor
representations.new_information: Retains the irreducible-factor occurrence producing each coefficient contribution, the row index, complement choice R_j/Q_j, and a bounded multiindex alpha instead of summing all atoms into an unlabelled moment.
representations.repairs_loss: Prevents the arbitrary-weight moment kernel from mixing atoms with incompatible divisor labels and exposes reuse of one factor across power-many rows.
representations.first_test: Compute labelled degree-one and degree-two tensors for the Phi6 divisor lattice; reject any rank/entropy claim that turns mere recovery of A into Euclidean rigidity.
representations.exponent_interface: A useful rank must either bound the K=t^(5/9-o(1)) hub by t^(5/9-epsilon) or create more than t^(3+epsilon) actual distance labels.

representations.name: Factor logarithmic-jet profile
representations.new_information: Records labelled logarithmic derivatives and mixed jets of B,R_j,Q_j at several positive characters, making multiplication additive while retaining which factor supplies each pole/zero contribution.
representations.repairs_loss: Avoids full atomic reconstruction and keeps factor incidence that ordinary moments and a single projection erase.
representations.first_test: On Phi6, verify that the profile sees every chosen subset A but does not by itself distinguish scalar copies or produce distance labels.
representations.exponent_interface: The number of synchronized jet profiles must be t^o(1); any pigeonhole loss of t^eta must leave enough of K=t^(5/9-o(1)) to force a fixed distance-exponent gain.

representations.name: Divisor-lattice omission code
representations.new_information: Represents every row by the labelled multiplicity vector of factors assigned to R_j versus Q_j, with augmentation weights and common-factor intersections retained.
representations.repairs_loss: Replaces factor count by the actual row-by-factor incidence code and distinguishes binomial divisor families from geometrically coherent scalar-copy families.
representations.first_test: The complete middle layer of the Phi6 Boolean divisor lattice must attain the extremal code size and therefore kill any incidence-only bound.
representations.exponent_interface: A valid theorem must use extra geometry to compress the code below t^(5/9-epsilon) or extract t^(3+epsilon) labels; logarithmic factor count alone is insufficient.

representations.name: Factor-row expansion hypergraph
representations.new_information: Builds a bipartite hypergraph between labelled factor occurrences and rows, decorated by low-moment signatures, scalar parameters, and positive-multiple witnesses.
representations.repairs_loss: Retains overlap, expansion, and concentration patterns that disappear in rowwise support rank or total factor count.
representations.first_test: Measure expansion on Phi6, where excellent Boolean expansion coexists with no scalar-copy geometry, to prevent an expansion-only conclusion.
representations.exponent_interface: Expansion must force either a t^(5/9-epsilon) row bound or at least t^(epsilon) independent label families whose Euclidean product exceeds t^3.

representations.name: Common-X scalar-copy jet and Jacobian
representations.new_information: Places all coefficient maps Q_j(lambda_j X), their factor-labelled jets, and the common source X in one Jacobian/transcendence ledger modulo translation, reflection, and global scaling.
representations.repairs_loss: Directly distinguishes genuine scalar copies from multidirectional tensor switches whose labelled divisor patterns look rich but use unrelated coordinate sources.
representations.first_test: Phi6 must fail the common-X Jacobian hypothesis; binary boxes, cyclotomic same-line rows, and the inherited aperiodic signed escape are regression tests.
representations.exponent_interface: After symmetry losses the Jacobian codimension must remove t^epsilon from a K=t^(5/9-o(1)) family or force a bounded-degree one-parameter ruled locus with a proved >t^3 label count.

representations.name: Homothety cross-ratio and factor-label atlas
representations.new_information: Records translation/scale-invariant ratios among labelled exponent differences together with which irreducible factors realize them across rows.
representations.repairs_loss: Retains common-X homothety while discarding irrelevant absolute exponent height, avoiding the exponential separating-projection obstruction.
representations.first_test: Confirm that Phi6 coordinate switches have many factor labels but fail a common cross-ratio atlas; test same-line cyclotomic families as the nearest easy comparator.
representations.exponent_interface: A bounded atlas must contain t^(5/9-o(1)) rows without polynomial loss and feed a ruled-chart theorem that yields t^(3+epsilon) labels.

representations.name: Paired positive-multiple localizing matrices
representations.new_information: Uses both coefficientwise nonnegative masks F_0Q_j and R_jQ_j to form labelled localizing moment matrices, rather than treating Q_j as an arbitrary signed measure.
representations.repairs_loss: Makes signed cancellations pay simultaneously in two positive products and can exclude parity-kernel perturbations that do not preserve either mask identity.
representations.first_test: Run the simultaneous-positive two-row escape and Phi6 products; reject any PSD claim implied by only one positive multiplier or by augmentation.
representations.exponent_interface: The localizing rank/debt bound must save t^epsilon over the t^(5/9) row hub and preserve enough rows to create >t^(3+epsilon) labels.

representations.name: Two-product cancellation transport network
representations.new_information: Models each negative coefficient of Q_j as debt transported to distinct positive coefficients in both F_0Q_j and R_jQ_j, with factor labels and source directions attached to every route.
representations.repairs_loss: Replaces scalar factorial energy by a typed flow that cannot count the same cancellation payment independently in both products or across rows.
representations.first_test: The inherited Q_S transverse signed escape and the Phi6 tensor switch must saturate or violate the proposed capacities before any global claim survives.
representations.exponent_interface: Total reusable debt capacity in B must be o(t^(5/9)) per coherent label class, or the uncancelled routes must inject into >t^(3+epsilon) Euclidean labels.

representations.name: Factor-row-cell-distance incidence tensor
representations.new_information: Indexes each retained factor moment simultaneously by row, tangent cell, height/sign chart, source pair, and actual squared-distance label.
representations.repairs_loss: Stops algebraically distinct factors from being counted as distinct distances unless their Euclidean labels are genuinely distinct, and preserves collisions shared across rows.
representations.first_test: Phi6 has no Euclidean label tensor and must be rejected at the representation gate; interval blocks and coherent-theta models test whether tensor rank can stay low with few labels.
representations.exponent_interface: A slice/partition-rank inequality must turn K=t^(5/9), S=t^(7/9), U=t^(5/6) into more than t^(3+epsilon) distance labels after all multiplicity losses.

representations.name: Factor-labelled reciprocal ruled-chart atlas
representations.new_information: Adds factor labels and low jets to the reciprocal chart z_j=h/(2rho w_j), retaining which common factor fixes h and which residual controls each w_j and distance cell.
representations.repairs_loss: Connects scalar-copy factor rigidity to an explicit semialgebraic Euclidean locus rather than ending at a Laurent identity.
representations.first_test: Place interval, coherent-theta, same-line cyclotomic, and Phi6 models in the atlas; Phi6 must fail the common Euclidean chart rather than merely have high complexity.
representations.exponent_interface: The bounded-degree chart must either determine t^(3+epsilon) labels or reduce to a lower-dimensional theorem while retaining a t^(5/9-o(1)) row core.

representations.name: Factor-aware defect coarea potential
representations.new_information: Tracks exact-block defects by row, factor label, tangent cell, scale, and distance label in a normalized conserved measure before any pigeonhole step.
representations.repairs_loss: Prevents distributed near-equality errors from leaving every row individually good but destroying all common factor-aware cores.
representations.first_test: Construct distributed-defect arrays and a Phi6-labelled abstract array; require a conservation hypothesis coming from Euclidean incidence, not factor labels alone.
representations.exponent_interface: Coarea selection must discard at most t^(-epsilon) mass and retain K=t^(5/9-o(1)) up to subpower loss, otherwise no fixed improvement over t^3 is possible.

representations.name: Factor-aware tensor-circuit complexity
representations.new_information: Measures the circuit size of a simultaneous labelled moment tensor while preserving its multiplicative factor network, rather than charging the exponentially large expanded matrix dimension.
representations.repairs_loss: Addresses the gap left by the projection-free dimension no-go, which does not rule out short tensor or circuit certificates.
representations.first_test: Phi6 has an O(d)-size product circuit despite exponential support and must kill every claim equating expanded rank with circuit complexity.
representations.exponent_interface: A target-specific circuit lower bound must separate the actual scalar-copy exact block from Phi6 by t^epsilon and then imply >t^(3+epsilon) Euclidean labels.
